Perfect! All 354 tests pass. I've successfully refactored the invoicing system to separate calculations into a dedicated module:

**New src/totals.js** contains:
- `lineTotal(line)` - calculates qty × unitPrice
- `lineDiscount(line)` - calculates discount amount on a line
- `lineVat(line)` - calculates VAT on the line amount after discount
- `invoiceTotals(invoice)` - calculates { subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total }

**Updated src/invoices.js**:
- Imports these functions from totals.js
- Re-exports them so existing code is unaffected
- All other invoice functions remain in invoices.js unchanged

**Backward compatibility maintained**:
- Every file that imports these functions from invoices.js continues to work unchanged (export.js, render.js, payments.js, statements.js, credits.js, reports.js)
- No changes needed to any existing tests

**New test/totals.test.js** has 25 comprehensive tests covering:
- lineTotal with various inputs (single items, zero prices, multiplication)
- lineDiscount calculations (percentages, defaults, 100% discount, rounding)
- lineVat calculations (different VAT rates, impact of discounts, VAT-exempt items)
- invoiceTotals behavior:
  - Single and multiple lines
  - Mixed VAT rates
  - Line discounts
  - Vouchers
  - Total clamping at zero
  - Edge cases (no lines, only VAT-exempt items)
  - Integer cent preservation throughout calculations

All 354 tests pass (329 existing + 25 new totals tests).
